SEPARATELY, re-reading both sides line-by-line while transcribing this (not from the probe's numeric output, since flat terrain makes the deck-slab Y identical either way) surfaced a REAL, already-live divergence: src/bridges.js:124 hardcodes `quad(conc, ...)` for the full-width deck slab regardless of bridge kind, while BridgeBuilder.cs's same block uses the per-kind `buf.Quad(...)` (stone for Dry Bridge, the one stone-kind bridge among the 11). Total compared values: roughly 11x10 (zones) + 11x20 (per-bridge geo) + 15 (totals) + 1 (round-tie) ~= 346.
